verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਰਿਦੈ ਪ੍ਰਥਮ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕੈ ਬਸੈ ਤਾ ਪਾਛੈ ਕਰਤ ਆਗਿਆ ਮਇਆ ਕੈ ਮਨਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: satigur sikh ridhai pratham kirapaa kai basai taa paachhai karat aagiaa miaa kai manaaviee ||

en.bdb: The True Guru becomes clement and enters the heart of a Sikh first. Then he asks the Sikh to meditate on Naam and showers his kindness to make him meditate.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਗਿਆ ਮਾਨਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਦਾਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲ ਨਿਜ ਪਦ ਪਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: aagiaa maan giaan gur param nidhaan dhaan gurmukh sukh fal nij padh paaviee ||

en.bdb: Obeying the command of the True Guru, a Guru-conscious person indulges in Naam Simran- a supreme treasure of the Lord and enjoys the spiritual comfort. He also attains the ultimate spiritual state.

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਧਾਮ ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਲਿਵ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਹਤ ਨ ਆਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: naam nihakaam dhaam sahaj samaadh liv agam agaadh kathaa kahat na aaviee ||

en.bdb: In that spiritual realm, he achieves that high state of Naam where all desires of reward or fruit vanish. Thus he gets engrossed in a deep concentration. This state is beyond description.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੋ ਜੈਸੋ ਭਾਉ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਤ ਪਦਾਰਬਿੰਦ ਸਕਲ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੈ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪੁਜਾਵਈ ॥੧੭੮॥
verses.translit_en: jaiso jaiso bhaau kar poojat padhaarabi(n)dh sakal sa(n)saar kai manorath pujaaviee ||178||

en.bdb: With whatever desires and sentiments one worships the True Guru, He fulfils all his wants and desires. (178)
